question: How can the universe be described if it abides in non-difference from Bhairava?
premises: The universe is also that same reality.
It is free from the stain-marks of time and other limiting factors.
It abides in non-difference from Bhairava.
inference: The universe, in its highest truth, is not limited by time and remains non-different from Bhairava.
uncertainties: The token '\hspace{3cm}' is editorial spacing, not a Sanskrit word; glossed minimally as spacer.
plain_english: That universe too is free from the stains of time and the rest, abiding in non-difference from Bhairava.
